[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 6-8 [[Plant Fiber]]s }} [[Guardian Moss]] is a kind of moss that is used to create medicines to cure various kinds of diseases. [[Luxon]] [[Monk]]s wear them around their necks as a symbol of their power and purpose in battle. ==Acquisition== * [[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] ** [[Kaineng City]] *** [[Island Guardian]] ** [[The Jade Sea]] *** Island Guardian ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Guardian Moss#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== [[Image:Island Guardian Spawns Pongmei Valley.jpg|thumb|left|Island Guardian spawn points in Pongmei Valley]] ====[[Pongmei Valley]]==== There are a total of six [[Island Guardian]]s, three of which are outside of [[Boreas Seabed (outpost)|Boreas Seabed]]. {{clear}} ==Collectors== {{:Luci/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|9th November 2009 and 11th November 2013|Maishang Hills|1 [[Guardian Moss]]}} == Notes == * This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Reun]] for his salad at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival. * The collector [[Luci]] trades 2 Guardian Moss for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is slightly greater than two times more than just selling the trophies by themselves.
